requirements.Title: AI Productivity & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-driven productivity features and manageability solutions into the Magellan printer, including AI-enhanced print, scan, and support workflows.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require easy management and productivity solutions to maximize efficiency, especially with limited IT resources.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, GXD, Quality, R&D Telemetry, BA
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan printer includes AI-driven print, scan, and support workflows demonstrable in product demo.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Printer Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal for device management targeting unmanaged or lightly managed SMBs, enabling office managers/generalist IT to easily monitor, configure, and manage multiple printers.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack dedicated IT teams and need simple, consolidated solutions for device management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal allows management of at least 6-15 printers, provides usage statistics, configuration, and support tools.

requirements.Title: Business Ink Tank Technology
requirements.Description: Magellan must be HP’s first business ink tank printer, offering cost-efficient, high-performance printing with minimal intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Address gap in CISS PLE Hi segment and safeguard HP’s ink/laser profit pool.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, Supplies Quality, Tech Reg, Prod Steward
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer utilizes ink tank technology, supports high-volume printing, and demonstrates lowest business TCO in comparative testing.

requirements.Title: Keyed Bottles for Ink Refills
requirements.Description: Implement keyed bottles to ensure correct and secure ink refilling, reducing user errors and maintenance calls.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user experience, reduces maintenance, and supports sustainability goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer only accepts keyed bottles for ink refills; nozzle mismatch is prevented.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever is first) for Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMB expectations for reliability and cost efficiency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty policy documented; printer tracks page count and warranty period.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design Magellan with a maintenance box that is easily replaceable by customers, reducing downtime and service needs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs have limited IT support; minimizing intervention is crucial.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by non-technical users; instructional material provided.

requirements.Title: PHA and MINK Serviceability
requirements.Description: Ensure PHA (customer replaceable parts) and MINK (replaceable at service centers) are available, with a target for customer replaceability if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes downtime and service costs for SMB customers.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, Marketing, Supplies Quality, Prod Steward
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Parts list includes PHA and MINK; documentation provided for replacement procedures.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU Performance Improvement
requirements.Description: PDL SKU must achieve print speeds of 25/20 ppm (improved from current 25/19) and support PDL/PS.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses performance needs for SMBs and competitive positioning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves specified print speeds and supports PDL/PS in testing.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: Magellan must meet Blue Angel environmental certification requirements for relevant SKUs.
requirements.Rationale: Supports sustainability and regulatory compliance; competitive differentiation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product receives Blue Angel certification for specified SKUs.

requirements.Title: Sustainability: 60% RCP Content
requirements.Description: Design Magellan to use at least 60% recycled content plastic (RCP), exceeding competitors (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Differentiates on sustainability; aligns with HP’s environmental goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Material sourcing and manufacturing documentation confirm 60% RCP content.

requirements.Title: Minimal Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Engineer Magellan for maintenance-free or reduced maintenance, minimizing parts to replace over printer life.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs value reliability and minimal intervention; competitive advantage.
requirements.Dependencies: Customer replaceable maintenance box, PHA/MINK serviceability
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance schedule shows reduced frequency and parts compared to competitors; user feedback confirms ease.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing through the HP App for Magellan users.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require flexibility and ease of use in printing workflows.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: HP App allows mobile print jobs; verified in user testing with SMB customers.

requirements.Title: PaaS Support
requirements.Description: Support Print-as-a-Service (PaaS) for Magellan, including SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses evolving business models and customer needs for flexible solutions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan integrates with PaaS offerings; tested in pilot deployments.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate telemetry features for real-time monitoring, usage analytics, and proactive support.
requirements.Rationale: Enables data-driven management and support for SMBs; aligns with HP’s digital strategy.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry system collects and reports printer usage and health data; validated in test environment.

requirements.Title: Advanced Scan Workflow
requirements.Description: Provide advanced scan workflow capabilities, leveraging AI for perfect scan results and efficient document management.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs need efficient document workflows; competitive feature.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Scan workflow demonstrates AI enhancements and efficiency improvements in user testing.
